nom: COOLA Dew Good Illuminating Serum Sunscreen with Probiotic Technology SPF 30

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the formula as lightweight and non-greasy, saying it did not add shine or break down under makeup the way other illuminating products had, though one felt the dewy finish was slightly too much for her oily zones.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum leaves their skin plumped and hydrated instead of chalky, though one with drier skin still layers a moisturizer and other serums underneath to get enough hydration.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who is oily in some areas and dry in others, describe the texture as blending evenly without emphasizing either zone, and report no new breakouts even with acne-prone combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive are split: several report no reaction and found the formula gentle, while others experienced burning, swelling, itching or a rash, in some cases linked to the shimmer ingredient bismuth oxychloride.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying her skin as normal found the formula breathable enough for daily wear alongside her anti-aging routine.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin say the formula avoids the dry, chalky look they associate with typical sunscreens and gives a natural glow without settling into fine lines.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on anti-aging value describe the SPF as a way to guard against sun-related wrinkles and photoaging without the dry, chalky finish they associate with other mineral sunscreens; one reviewer notes it slightly emphasizes the fine lines around her eyes.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin, including one using it through winter, report it leaves skin plumped and hydrated rather than dry or dull; one reviewer with drier skin says she still layers it with a moisturizer and other serums to get enough hydration.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers, some of whom say they don't normally have sensitive skin, describe a delayed reaction after weeks or months of use — burning, swelling, redness and peeling that several trace to the shimmer ingredient bismuth oxychloride destabilizing in the bottle over time; many other reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers citing the probiotic technology describe their skin as more hydrated and 'supported' with continued use, and none report the probiotics themselves causing problems.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says this is the only non-acne-targeted product that has cleared her acne, and another with acne-prone combination skin reports no breakouts even during a flare-up; a reviewer with very sensitive skin cautions that without a double cleanse afterward, it may cause minor breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the formula absorbs without adding grease or heaviness and, unlike other illuminating products they've tried, doesn't break down into an oily mess under makeup; one reviewer with oily skin found the dewy finish slightly too much for her.

aspects.libelle: Pump or bottle breaks over time
No white cast across skin tones

extraits.texte: Thank goodness for the negative reviews that came before mine - I am relieved to have ID'd the ingredient I reacted so horribly to! I bought and used this product in the summer without any issue. Gives a beautiful finish (though I did experience some white caste but only along my jawline/neck for some reason). Loved it and wore it daily in the summer months but used another sunscreen come fall. I decided to give it a whirl about five months after I purchased it and was greeted with a terrible reaction - swollen bright red face + burning and itching sensations lasting several days. I tried it again a couple months later to confirm it was the culprit and that it did. It's definitely the bismuth oxychloride and something obviously happened over time to make it more aggravating to those with sensitive skin. Major bummer because it looks great! But definitely causes an awful reaction to those with sensitivity issues.

The subtle luminosity gives my mature skin a youthful radiance that appears to come from within rather than sitting artificially on top.The ability to protect, hydrate, and perfect my complexion in a single step has been amazing for my skincare routine. There are so many features to love about Coola's Dew Good Illuminating Serum. I have made this my new facial SPF, and let me tell you why. I love this for my dry skin which becomes extra dry and dull during the winter months. It instantly refreshes and hydrates my skin, giving a lit from within glow that looks perfect on its own or paired with other skincare and makeup products. The dewy look lasts several hours while my skins stay hydrated all day. This product does have a typical sunscreen smell which doesn't bother me; however, others may not enjoy the smell or find it too strong, especially if using other scented products on or near the face. Additionally, this serum provides good coverage with SPF 30 and protects against blue light and environmental stressors. Overall, this serum is effective in hydrating and protecting my skin. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As someone who lives in a humid and hot environment with acne-prone combination skin, I tend to avoid glowy products as they usually end up looking greasy and oily on me. However, this product really blew my expectations away! The iridescent exterior design on the bottle is only a sneak preview of what it provides to my skin. I got an immediate glow after applying it that showed through my makeup while still looking natural and not causing any pilling or making me look greasy, which was amazing! The pump is super convenient as I can pump the serum directly onto my face. What was also interesting is that the consistency is more thick, but that makes it much easier for a direct application onto my face as it doesn't drip everywhere. It definitely has the texture and consistency akin to a sunscreen, but it applies very smoothly and doesn't leave me with any white cast. It does smell like sunscreen too, but that doesn't bother me at all. It's super convenient to get to skip a step in my skincare routine too, as this product covers both the serum and sunscreen step of my morning lineup. When applying it under makeup and wearing it for a fully day (10+ hours), it doesn't cause me any issues which is super helpful as I usually need products to last from early morning to evening time. While my skin isn't sensitive, it can break out if I use comedogenic products so I'm happy to see that this doesn't clog my skin at all and is a "safe" product to use even in the midst of a breakout. I tend to be skeptical of illuminators as a person with oily skin. A lot of them feel like they "break" apart underneath my makeup and just leave me an oilier than ever mess. That wasn't the case here, I'm so pleasantly surprised by "Dew Good."Packaged in gorgeous iridescent bottle this serum delivers moisture, a brighter complexion and SPF protection. There is no white cast (win for brown skin everywhere), it just melts into your skin and leaves you with a healthy glow. I love that this also adds a nice boost of Vitamin C and hyaluronic to my routine. Definitely want to do a special shoutout to the probiotic ingredients in this formula – my skin loves anything formulated with probiotics as it helps enrich your natural skin barrier. The fact that it's a clean product, SPF protection, and actual skincare has made me fall in love.My only note here is that if you're like me and have super sensitive skin- a double cleanse is needed after use. Otherwise, it may cause some minor breakouts. That isn't enough for me to dock it of any stars – it's just too good. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love a good multitasking sunscreen, and the Coola Dew Good Illuminating Serum SPF 30 really leaves my skin with a gorgeous and healthy complexion. Since my skin is normal, I look for sunscreens that feel breathable and comfortable while also supporting my anti-aging routine, and this one checks all the boxes.The texture is serum-like and silky, blending effortlessly into the skin without feeling greasy or heavy, no white cast whatsoever. It provides broad-spectrum SPF 30 protection, which is great for daily wear, and the illuminating effect gives my complexion a dewy, lit-from-within look without looking oily. It layers well and doesn't pill, which is a huge plus.I appreciate the skincare benefits in this formula, it feels hydrating and nourishing while keeping my skin protected from sun damage. The glow it gives is natural and fresh, making it perfect for no-makeup days or as a radiant base. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Besides being such a pretty bottle, this sunscreen serum is the perfect addition to my daily skincare. It's not too thick or to light on my skin and provides such a great glow. It has a nice light scent that is not too overpowering, and blends smoothly on my skin. It also blends well with my tinted moisturizer! I have drier skin and need to combine with moisturizer and other serums to increase needed hydration. I'm looking forward to using this sunscreen this spring szn. It's also a great option whenever I dont want to wear any makeup but want a nice glow/dewy natural look! You might need to blend really well if you add a certain amount to avoid a "white cast" but, with enough blending this cast turns into a glowy look.
